resources.string: Install individual security tools into this Linux environment. Only the tool you choose is installed.

These are powerful security tools, provided for authorised testing and education only. Only scan, probe or attack systems you own or have explicit written permission to test. You are responsible for following all applicable laws and policies.\n\nTermiNow installs the exact tool you choose into your Linux environment — it never installs a large metapackage and never runs any scan or attack by itself.

Running security tools on a remote host over SSH is not available in this build; install and run them in a local Linux environment.

Capture only on networks and interfaces you own or are explicitly authorised to test. Captures are bounded in time and size and are written to a file in this Linux environment — nothing is uploaded anywhere automatically, and no capture content is ever sent to AI or any third-party service by TermiNow.\n\nLive capture needs the tcpdump tool, and analysis needs TShark; install them from Security tools if they are missing. Capturing on a real interface usually needs root in the environment.

This environment runs as root inside PRoot, but the Android kernel does not grant it raw-packet (CAP_NET_RAW) access, so live capture here is not possible. You can still analyse a .pcap file in Analyse, or run a capture on a remote Linux host from Hosts → Packet capture.
